title: LRU Cache
description:
Keep at most capacity key/value pairs, discarding the least recently used pair when room is needed.

Implement the LRUCache class:

  • __init__(capacity: int) creates an empty cache of positive capacity.
  • get(key: int) -> int returns the stored value or -1 if the key is absent; a successful get marks its key as recently used.
  • put(key: int, value: int) -> None inserts or overwrites a pair, marking it as recently used; if this creates excess entries, evicts the least recently used key.

A missing get does not change usage order. Overwriting an existing key also counts as use. The least recently used key is the one with the oldest successful get or put; insertion is a use.

You are graded on a recorded sequence of calls on one live object. The first call names the class and passes constructor arguments; subsequent calls name methods and their arguments. The constructor and methods returning nothing report null; the result array has one entry per call.

Constraints:

  • 1 <= capacity <= 3000.
  • Keys and values are integers between 0 and 100000.
  • At most 30000 calls; get and put should run in amortized O(1) time.

Example 1:

Calls: ["LRUCache","put","put","get","put","get","get"]
Arguments: [[2],[1,1],[2,2],[1],[3,3],[2],[3]]
Output: [null,null,null,1,null,-1,3]

Reading 1 makes 2 least recent, so the new entry evicts 2.

Example 2:

Calls: ["LRUCache","put","put","get","put","get","get"]
Arguments: [[2],[1,10],[2,20],[2],[3,30],[1],[2]]
Output: [null,null,null,20,null,-1,20]

The read of 2 protects it; insertion of 3 evicts 1.

Example 3:

Calls: ["LRUCache","put","put","get","put","get"]
Arguments: [[1],[7,4],[7,9],[7],[8,3],[7]]
Output: [null,null,null,9,null,-1]

Overwriting 7 keeps one entry, but adding 8 evicts it.

Overwriting 7 keeps one entry, but adding 8 evicts it.
A missing read gives -1; zero is still a stored value.
A miss on 9 does not rescue the oldest key 1.
A series of hits changes which old entry is evicted next.
Zero is a valid key and value, and is evicted at capacity one.
Three different entries fit without eviction.
Refreshing an existing key does not increase size.
